title: Space Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 🪐️space plugin (multi-app: 🏠️home launcher + 🪐️space studio, plus a 🤝️shared module) from its old 16-crate constitutional layout to one taxonomy crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪐️space/📦️packages/🦀️rust, following TEMPLATE.md and the gis worked precedent (2 apps in 1 crate). Determine real document-schema boundary (home vs space apps) from actual engine/dsl code, not directory names — initial read shows space's document type may be OS-kernel-owned (WorkflowDocument/OS_SPACE_SCHEMA), which changes the artifact-count analysis. Full recipe per TEMPLATE §0-§9, registrar handoff only (never touch root Cargo.toml).
summary:
W3+ migration of 🪐️space (multi-app OS host plugin: 🏠️home launcher + 🪐️space studio, plus a plugin-level shared kernel) from its 16 old constitutional crates into ONE new crate `semio-s-plugin-space` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪐️space/📦️packages/🦀️rust/, with a full taxonomy source tree wired from a plugin-root 📦️lib.rs via explicit #[path] declarations (38 new .rs files).

Key architectural finding (from reading the old code before writing anything, not guessed from directory names): this plugin does NOT use the semio_plugin! macro — it's the OS host plugin, keeping the pre-migration manual PluginBundle builder + plugin_exports! invocation (documented explicitly in the old bundle crate's own doc comment as a deliberate deviation). More importantly, the 🪐️space app owns NO document type of its own — its DocumentApp::Projection/Operation are semio_framework_os::{WorkflowDocument, WorkflowOperation}, a kernel-owned type re-exported by os-core. Only the 🏠️home launcher app owns a real document (SHomeDocument). Consequence: there is exactly ONE 🗿️artifacts node in the new crate (🏠️home, with the full diff/op/dsl/pack/spr set), NOT two — 🪐️space's would-be "artifact" content (parameter/workflow-node/media-contract/compiled-dag compute over the kernel WorkflowDocument) instead lives in an app-level 🦀️engine.rs file (space had no artifact to put it under), matching how the OLD space_engine crate was already app-scoped, not artifact-scoped, for exactly this reason. Fixtures/document helpers genuinely shared by both apps (demo studio DSL fixture, draw/writer fixture registration) moved to a new plugin-root 🫀️core/ kernel, not duplicated.

Command decomposition: both apps' Command enums (HomeCommand: 8 rows, SpaceCommand: 46 rows) were rebuilt with app_commands!, one nested `pub mod <verb> { struct + handle() }` per row grouped into 3 files for home (🏙️studio, 🗂️vfs, ⚙️settings) and 12 files for space (🔢️parameters, 🧩️nodes, 🔗️connections, 🗂️selection, 🖱️viewport, 💬️engagement, ✏️graph-edit, 👥️presence, 🖼️media, 💾️studio-io, 🔍️instance-nav, 🧭️navigation) — both DocumentApp::handle impls collapsed to `command.dispatch(doc, cfg)`, command_id to `command.command_id()`. Manifests stitched via .mode_def()/.window_kind_def()/.panel_tab_def() passthroughs from per-node definition() fns (home: 1 mode/1 window; space: 1 mode/3 windows/3 panels, one WindowMeasure option node). Every test from every one of the 16 old crates' Cargo.toml files was preserved and relocated to its new home (command-group files, config.rs, engine.rs, panel files, or the two apps' cross-cutting testkit/tests regions) — none dropped.

**Could NOT be verified green in this session — see 🧪️verification-attempt.txt for the full diagnostic transcript.** This sandbox's native `cc` linker is blocked repo-wide by an unaccepted Xcode license (confirmed via a completely unrelated control: a brand-new `cargo new hello_test && cargo build` fails identically). `cargo metadata` DID succeed (full dependency graph resolves cleanly) and extensive manual cross-referencing (every pub mod name vs every use site; every .rs file vs every #[path] declaration; grep for zero leftover references to any of the 16 old crate names) was done in place of a compiler, catching and fixing one real bug (a render() dispatch match arm compared against a locally-duplicated constant instead of the correct one — harmless by coincidence since both constants held the same string value, but wrong on inspection). Because green cannot be proven, the old 16 crates were deliberately NOT deleted, and the temporary Cargo.toml [workspace] verification overlay was deliberately left in place (needed for the next session to actually run cargo check/clippy/test). One real cross-cutting dependent was found (dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep's Cargo.toml + a `use home::SHomeDocument` line) and deliberately left pointed at the still-working OLD crate rather than repointed onto the unverified new one — the exact one-line+one-import fix is documented in 📋️registrar-handoff.md for whichever session verifies this green next.
